# Lucent · 灵感台

> A calm browser homepage over a small living world. Built by hydeclanspi as a custom homepage for the Aira browser on HarmonyOS, published here as a web edition. Vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canvas and SVG; no framework, no runtime dependency, no network request after load.

Lucent looks like a homepage: a clock, a profile card, search, shortcuts. Under that surface run four systems:

- Lueurs (小浮光, codename 代号：交互): 49 numbered glass lenses in a hand-drawn 35-vertex region. Motion is an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck heading process with velocity relaxation; contacts are resolved by 4 px sub-stepped impulse physics (restitution 0.64, speed cap 640 px/s) with an eight-direction scattering score. Drive (FSD) is a roam/chase/charge/coast state machine on a breadth-first navigation grid with line-of-sight path simplification. Natural encounters are adjudicated at 70% inside a 150 px circle. Placement ("落子与星座") is weighted sequential sampling that punishes deserts and crowding. Dragging a lens moves an invisible potential field that sets the Light/Dark wallpaper odds.
- Liquid glass (通透玻璃): a six-parameter material model (transparency, blur, warmth, edge, colour, touch) mapped to layered optics — ambient warm/cool reflections, a masked 1.5 px rim, inset thickness, and a pointer-following specular point coalesced to one animation frame. No permanent animation loop.
- 念起，光行 (A thought, in flight): six search hand-off motions selected from a sixteen-study atelier. Each Canvas renderer is a pure function of progress, so frames can be scrubbed, slowed to 0.35× and reversed. Random mode adds platinum conduits and blue-white current whose speed is sampled from a truncated normal N(0.70, 0.10²) and whose waves never share a lane.
- 场志 (Field chronicle): checksummed dual-slot snapshots (FNV-1a over canonical JSON), hierarchical time compaction (hour → day → month → year) under a byte budget, histogram re-binning that preserves totals by the largest-remainder method, and a self-verifying clipboard backup format (deflate-raw, base64url, CRC-32, segmented).

Verification: 37 unit tests (engine invariants such as momentum conservation, no tunnelling, connected placement chamber, line-of-sight routes; renderer determinism over 21,618 progress states; storage integrity) and 15 browser flows run in CI.
